徐子宁实在忍不住翻了个白眼，他妈咪真是路痴到家了，跟着指示牌走都能拐到另外一边去。
“哥哥，哥哥……”听到宁宁的声音，一双大眼睛，穿着粉色连衣公主裙的又一萌娃小萝莉徐欢颜小跑过来，猛得扑倒在他怀里。
宁宁丢掉行李箱，接住徐欢颜，一把抱住她，佯怒道，“欢欢，不许乱跑，你身体本来就不好，小心摔着了。”
欢欢嘟着可爱的小嘴，一双大眼睛亮晶晶的，甜甜的撒娇道，“有哥哥在，不怕。”
宁宁顿时满足了。
唐可然，哦，不，现在叫徐雅然，只见她一身白色宽松休闲衫，外面套一件嫩黄色薄外套，若隐若现的露出里面黑色的bra，十分性感。下身穿了一条紧身牛仔裤，脚上穿着一双水晶高跟鞋。一头漂亮的长发垂在胸前，容貌出众，气质高贵，性感高挑。
徐雅然走上前，看着宁宁和欢欢，撅了撅嘴，“宝贝，对不起，妈咪又走错路了……”
欢欢从宁宁身上下来，大方的摆了摆手，“没事，妈咪，我们都已经习惯了！”
徐雅然，o(╯□╰)o……
看着自家妈咪郁闷的样子，宁宁不忍，忙开口，“妈咪，我们快走吧，静姨还在外面等着我们呢。”
“嗯。”徐雅然点头，宁宁很自觉的拖着两个行李箱往外走，留下两手空空的徐雅然和欢欢。
“哇塞，快看，那对宝贝是异卵双胞胎吗？两个人长得一模一样呢，好萌啊！”
“快看快看，那个女宝粉嫩嫩的，好可爱好心水，好想要一个这样的女儿啊啊啊！”
“那个男宝才好看，你看那张脸，长大以后肯定是个祸害！天呐，他居然在对我笑，我被秒杀了，天呐，我真恨自己早生了几十年……”
“切，少扯了你，就算你晚生几十年，人家也看不上你！”
“谁说的，我看你是看我不顺眼吧！”
“我是让你要点脸，居然觉得人家会看上你，切！”
“我揍死你……”
……然后两人打了起来。

徐家三口，o(╯□╰)o……
徐雅然吸了一口气，顿了半响，小声道，“宁宁，没事别乱笑……”
“妈咪，是你教的，凡事微笑面对，笑脸迎人，开开心心才是王道。”宁宁回头，给了徐雅然一个大大的Happy微笑。
果然很秒杀人啊，徐雅然在心里道，他家儿子肿么就那么帅的！啊啊啊，果然是我亲生的，基因就是好！
“啊啊啊，他居然又对我笑了，谁说她看不上我的……”而那边，打得更欢快了。
徐雅然顿住，无语凝噎，“还是别乱笑了，咱又不是卖笑的，再说容易引发交通混乱……”
“……”宁宁无语望天。
“哥哥，哥哥，我要尿尿，憋不住了……”欢欢突然道。
女人真是麻烦！
宁宁撇嘴，摊手无奈，转身，放下两个行李箱，对徐雅然道，“妈咪，你坐在这里乖乖别动，我带欢欢去洗手间。”然后又对欢欢道，“欢欢，以后要说去洗手间，不可以那么粗俗！”说完带着欢欢走了。
徐雅然心安理得的找了个座位玩手机，反正有她的宝贝儿子在，万事很放心。
宁宁下了飞机后就把这个机场的构造映在了脑子里，当然知道洗手间在哪，把欢欢带去女洗手间后，便在门口等她。
章贺刚从男洗手间出来，就被萌娃小正太宁宁吸引住了眼球，不是因为他长得有多么萌多么可爱，多么令人心水，而是……他那张脸，跟他们夜爵老大好相似哇，仿佛就是小号的夜爵老大啊！
章贺顿时瞪大眼睛盯着徐子宁，宁宁心中警铃大启，脸色顿时有些不好！
“真的好像啊！”章贺感叹道。
尤其是他现在不笑的样子，跟夜爵老大不仅容颜相似，气质相似，连眼神也相似，仿佛就是夜爵老大出现在面前！！
想到这里，章贺猛地打了个寒颤，又想起夜爵冷笑惩罚他的样子，好可怕好可怕！
宁宁侧了侧身，躲过章贺直勾勾的眼神，心里却盘算着，这男人的眼神里除了惊愕，貌似没有恶意，甚至有些惧怕他，好奇怪！

A cute little boy wearing a jazz hat, a blue and black plaid shirt, and khaki slacks appeared in people's sight. He was seen dragging two suitcases, one large and one small. He turned back coolly, and shouted in anger at his misfortune, "Mommy, sister, this way, the exit is over here..."
Xu Zining couldn't help but rolled his eyes. His mother was such a roadie that she could turn to the other side just by following the signs.
"Brother, brother..." Hearing Ning Ning's voice, Xu Huanyan, another cute little girl with big eyes and wearing a pink princess dress, trotted over and threw herself into his arms.
Ning Ning threw away her suitcase, caught Xu Huanyan, hugged her, and said in a feint of anger, "Huanhuan, don't run around. You are not in good health to begin with. Be careful of falling."
Huanhuan pouted her cute little mouth, her big eyes were bright, and she said sweetly and coquettishly, "My brother is here, don't be afraid."
Ning Ning was immediately satisfied.
Tang Keran, oh, no, her name is Xu Yaran now. She was wearing a white loose casual shirt with a thin yellow jacket on the outside. The black bra underneath was looming, which was very sexy. He was wearing a pair of tight jeans and a pair of crystal high heels. She has beautiful long hair hanging down on her chest, outstanding appearance, noble temperament, sexy and tall.
Xu Yaran stepped forward, looked at Ningning and Huanhuan, and pouted, "Baby, I'm sorry, Mommy went the wrong way again..."
Huanhuan got off Ningning and waved her hand generously, "It's okay, Mommy, we are all used to it!"
Xu Yaran, o(╯□╰)o……
Seeing her mother's depressed look, Ning Ning couldn't bear it and hurriedly said, "Mommy, let's go quickly, Aunt Jing is still waiting for us outside."
"Yes." Xu Yaran nodded, and Ning Ning consciously dragged the two suitcases out, leaving Xu Yaran and Huanhuan empty-handed.
"Wow, look, are those babies fraternal twins? They look exactly the same, so cute!"
"Look, look, that baby girl is pink and tender, so cute and adorable. I really want a daughter like this!"
"That baby boy is so good-looking. Look at that face. He will definitely be a disaster when he grows up! God, he was actually smiling at me. I was instantly killed. God, I really hate that I was born decades earlier..."
"Tch, stop talking about it. Even if you are born decades later, people will still look down on you!"
"Who said that? I think you don't like me!"
"I asked you to save some face, but you actually think that people will like you, Tsk!"
"I'll beat you to death..."
...Then the two started fighting.
The Xu family of three, o(╯□╰)o……
Xu Yaran took a breath, paused for a while, and whispered, "Ning Ning, don't laugh when it's okay..."
"Mommy, you taught me to smile at everything, welcome people with a smile, and be happy is the way to go." Ning Ning turned around and gave Xu Yaran a big happy smile.
Sure enough, he kills people in seconds, Xu Yaran thought in her heart, why is his son so handsome! Ahhhhh, he is indeed my biological child, his genes are good!
"Ahhhh, he actually smiled at me again. Who said she doesn't like me..." On the other side, the fight was even more cheerful.
Xu Yaran paused, speechless and choked, "It's better not to laugh randomly, we are not a joker, and besides, it can easily cause traffic chaos..."
"..." Ning Ning looked at the sky speechlessly.
"Brother, brother, I need to pee, I can't hold it in anymore..." Huanhuan said suddenly.
Women are such trouble!
Ning Ning curled her lips, spread her hands helplessly, turned around, put down the two suitcases, and said to Xu Yaran, "Mommy, sit here and don't move, I will take Huanhuan to the bathroom." Then she said to Huanhuan, "Huanhuan, don't be so vulgar when talking about going to the bathroom in the future!" After that, he took Huanhuan away.
Xu Yaran felt at ease and found a seat to play with her mobile phone. Anyway, she had her baby.With my son here, everything is at ease.
After Ning Ning got off the plane, she had the structure of the airport in her mind. Of course she knew where the restroom was. After taking Huanhuan to the women's restroom, she waited for her at the door.
As soon as Zhang He came out of the men's room, his eyes were caught by the cute little boy Ning Ning, not because he was so cute and cute, but because... his face was so similar to their boss Ye Jue, as if he was the trumpet boss Ye Jue!
Zhang He suddenly stared at Xu Zining with wide eyes. Ning Ning's heart was alarmed, and her face suddenly looked bad!
"It really looks like it!" Zhang He sighed.
Especially the way he is not smiling now, he not only looks similar to Boss Ye Jue, but also has a similar temperament, and even his eyes are similar, as if Boss Ye Jue is appearing in front of him! !
Thinking of this, Zhang He shuddered violently, and then remembered the way Ye Jue sneered and punished him. It was so scary, so scary!
Ning Ning turned sideways to avoid Zhang He's direct gaze, but she was thinking in her heart. Apart from shock, this man's eyes seemed to have no malice, and he was even a little afraid of him. How strange!
